import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DifferentialOrder
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4AffineDifferentialFrame
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LinearEquivalenceAPI
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DifferentialOrderRegular

/-!
# Divisors of rational differentials

The local orders of a nonzero rational differential on a quasi-compact smooth
integral curve have finite support. On a standard-smooth affine neighborhood,
a common frame reduces this to finite support for rational functions; the
complement of that neighborhood is finite. This constructs the divisor of a
rational differential used for the canonical class in Hartshorne II.8 and IV.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace FiniteDimensional

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- Only finitely many local orders of a nonzero rational differential are
nonzero on a quasi-compact smooth integral curve. -/
theorem curveDifferentialOrder_support_finite [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    {p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left} |
      curveDifferentialOrder X p.2 ω hω ≠ 0}.Finite := by
  haveI : Smooth X.hom := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 X.hom
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  haveI : CompactSpace X.left := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace X.hom
  haveI : IsNoetherian X.left := ⟨⟩
  obtain ⟨U, _, hηU, η, hη, hframes⟩ := smoothCurve_exists_affine_differentialFrame X
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' η hη).mp
    (finrank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X) ω
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hω
    rw [← ha, hz, zero_smul]
  let g : X.left.functionFieldˣ := Units.mk0 a ha0
  have hZ : ((U : Set X.left)ᶜ).Finite :=
    finite_closed_of_avoids_genericPoint
      (fun _ _ h => smoothCurve_specializes_eq_genericPoint_or_eq X.hom h)
      U.isOpen.isClosed_compl (by simpa using hηU)
  refine ((hZ.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn).union
    (orderZAt_support_finite X.hom g)).subset ?_
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpU : p.1 ∈ U
  · right
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hframes p.1 hpU
    have hωe : (g : X.left.functionField) • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) = ω := by
      rw [he]
      exact ha
    have horder : curveDifferentialOrder X p.2 ω hω =
        Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom p.2 g) := by
      have hne : (g : X.left.functionField) • (e 1 : CurveRationalDifferentials X) ≠ 0 :=
        hωe ▸ hω
      simpa only [hωe] using curveDifferentialOrder_smul_frame X p.2 e g hne
    intro hz
    apply hp
    rw [horder, hz, toAdd_one]
  · exact Or.inl hpU

variable [IsAlgClosed k] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- The divisor of a specified nonzero rational differential. Its coefficients
are independent of local frames, though the divisor depends on the differential. -/
def differentialDivisor (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    CurveDivisor k X :=
  Finsupp.onFinset (curveDifferentialOrder_support_finite X ω hω).toFinset
    (fun p => curveDifferentialOrder X p.2 ω hω)
    (fun _ hp => (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr hp)

/-- The coefficient of the differential divisor is the local differential order. -/
@[simp]
theorem coeffAt_differentialDivisor (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    CurveDivisor.coeffAt hx (differentialDivisor X ω hω) =
      curveDifferentialOrder X hx ω hω := rfl

/-- Multiplying a rational differential by a rational function adds the
principal divisor of the function. -/
theorem differentialDivisor_smul (a : X.left.functionFieldˣ)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (haω : (a : X.left.functionField) • ω ≠ 0) :
    differentialDivisor X ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω) haω =
      principalDivisor a + differentialDivisor X ω hω := by
  apply CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt
  intro x hx
  simp only [coeffAt_differentialDivisor, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add,
    coeffAt_principalDivisor]
  exact curveDifferentialOrder_smul X hx a ω hω haω

/-! Scaling a nonzero rational differential by a unit is automatically
nonzero, so the divisor identity does not require a repeated side condition. -/
theorem differentialDivisor_smul_of_nonzero (a : X.left.functionFieldˣ)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    differentialDivisor X ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω)
        (smul_ne_zero (Units.ne_zero a) hω) =
      principalDivisor a + differentialDivisor X ω hω := by
  exact differentialDivisor_smul X a ω hω (smul_ne_zero (Units.ne_zero a) hω)

/-- Nonnegative coefficients of a differential divisor mean precisely that
the differential is regular at that point. -/
theorem coeffAt_differentialDivisor_nonneg_iff
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    0 ≤ CurveDivisor.coeffAt hx (differentialDivisor X ω hω) ↔
      ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x :=
  curveDifferentialOrder_nonneg_iff X hx ω hω

/-- The divisors of any two nonzero rational differentials are linearly
equivalent: their ratio is a nonzero rational function. -/
theorem differentialDivisor_linearlyEquivalent
    (ω η : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) (hη : η ≠ 0) :
    LinearlyEquivalent (differentialDivisor X ω hω) (differentialDivisor X η hη) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' ω hω).mp
    (finrank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X) η
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hη
    rw [← ha, hz, zero_smul]
  let g : X.left.functionFieldˣ := Units.mk0 a ha0
  have hne : (g : X.left.functionField) • ω ≠ 0 := ha ▸ hη
  have hD : differentialDivisor X η hη =
      principalDivisor g + differentialDivisor X ω hω := by
    simpa only [show (g : X.left.functionField) • ω = η from ha] using
      differentialDivisor_smul X g ω hω hne
  rw [hD]
  exact linearlyEquivalent_principalDivisor_add _ g

end
end Hartshorne
